row.title: STATIC-CONTENT-1: a page that never changes is a failure mode
row.body: Rowan 2026-11-25: static content is not autonomous. foundation/staticcontent.py hashes each system's sitemap pages daily into ops/static-content.json and the static-content detector fails when a page is unchanged for max_unchanged_days; a young ledger is unmeasured, never a pass.
